PRIVACY POLICY - Pinnacle Blooms Network unit of Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Pvt. Ltd.



Pinnacle Blooms Network, a specialized unit of Bharath HealthCare Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. ("Pinnacle"), is managed and operated by Bharath HealthCare Laboratories P LIMITED ("Company"). We offer a range of specialized Multi-Sensory, Multi-Disciplinary, and Integrated Autism Therapy Services ("Services"). Upholding the privacy and security of your personal information is of paramount importance to us. This Privacy Policy serves as a comprehensive guide detailing how we collect, utilize, disclose, and safeguard your personal information across various platforms including our website ("Site"), mobile application ("App"), and in-person consultations. By engaging with our Site, App, or any of our Services, you are affirming that you have thoroughly read, understood, and consented to the terms laid out in this Privacy Policy.

##

1. Information Collection



1.1. We collect personal information directly from you when you use our services, interact with our Site, App, Co-Workers, or communicate with us. The personal information collected may include, but is not limited to:

- Your name, contact details, whatsapp account, telegram account, postal address, and email address.

- Health-related information and medical history provided during appointments and consultations.

- Payment and transaction details if you make a purchase through the Site.

1.2. Additionally, we may collect certain non-personal information automatically when you access the Site, such as IP addresses, browser type, operating system, and usage data. This information is used to enhance your user experience and improve the functionality of the Site.

##

2. Use of Information



2.1. The personal information collected is used for the following explicit purposes:

- Providing Pinnacle Services with utmost care and accuracy.
- Facilitating payment processing and issuing receipts for services purchased, maintaining full financial transparency.
- Responding to your inquiries, requests, and feedback promptly and efficiently.
- Sending appointment reminders and important updates related to our services, ensuring your convenience and satisfaction.
- Improving the quality of our services and the functionality of the Site through continuous enhancement and innovation.
- Complying with all legal obligations and regulations to ensure data privacy and protection.

2.2. The Company expressly reserves the unilateral right to utilize your personal information for objectives divergent from those initially disclosed, either in strict compliance with applicable legal mandates or as expressly permitted by statutory provisions, or upon securing your unequivocal, informed consent.

##

3. Information Sharing


3.1. We respect the confidentiality of your personal information and limit its sharing to a select group of trusted entities and professionals for specific purposes, including:

- Administrative, Supportive healthcare, therapy professionals and staff at Pinancle directly involved in providing services to you, ensuring top-notch medical attention.
- Third-party service providers engaged to assist in appointment scheduling, payment processing, and other necessary support services.
- Legal and regulatory authorities, but only when required by law or to protect our rights and interests.

3.2. We will never sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes or any unauthorized use.

##

4. Data Security



4.1. We take your data security very seriously and have implemented stringent technical and organizational measures to safeguard your personal information from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.

4.2. Despite our efforts, no data transmission over the internet or electronic storage system can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. However, we continually monitor and update our security practices to stay ahead of emerging threats.

##

5. Retention of Information


5.1. We will retain your personal information for only as long as necessary to fulfill the explicit purposes for which it was collected, as required by law, and to comply with our legal obligations.

5.2. Should you wish to have your personal information permanently removed from our records, please contact us, and we will expedite the process. Refer our Contact Information section.

##

6. Third-Party Links & Ads


6.1. The Site may contain links to third-party websites or advertisements. However, we are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of such third-party websites. We recommend reviewing the privacy policies of these websites before providing any personal information to them.

##

7. International Users


7.1. Pinnacle Site, App and Services are operated from India. By using our services and accessing the Site, App from outside India, you acknowledge and expressly consent to the transfer and processing of your personal information in India. Refer overall policies of Pinnacle as the most comprehensive amongst the policies would triump.

##

8. Children's Privacy


8.1 Refer our Age Restriction Policy

##

9. Changes to the Privacy Policy


9.1. We reserve the right to modify, update, or change this Privacy Policy at any time without prior notice. By continuing to use Pinnacle Service you agree for the updated terms of this Privacy Policy, By continuing to use Pinnacle Services, You forefiet your right to challenge this decision. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically.

##

10. Contact Information



If you have any questions, concerns, or requests related to this Privacy Policy or the use of your personal information, please contact us at: You can refer our Contact Information section for updated contact info.

##

11. Language Versions



11.1. In the event of any discrepancy or inconsistency between translations of this Privacy Policy in different languages, the English version shall prevail.

##

12. Privacy Policy Acknowledgment



12.1. By accessing and utilizing the Site, Application, and associated services, you hereby affirm that you have meticulously read, comprehensively understood, and unequivocally consent to the terms stipulated in this Privacy Policy. Furthermore, you irrevocably forfeit any and all rights to challenge or dispute the validity or enforceability of any provision within this Privacy Policy

##

13. Entire Agreement


13.1. This Privacy Policy represents the complete and exclusive agreement between you and Pinnacle, with respect to the subject matter herein. This Policy supersedes all prior or contemporaneous understandings, communications, and proposals, whether verbal, written, or electronic, between you and Pinnacle concerning the collection, use, disclosure, and protection of your personal information.

At Pinnacle, we strive to protect your privacy diligently and transparently. This Privacy Policy reflects our unwavering commitment to your data privacy and security. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us by refering our Contact Information section. Thank you for entrusting us with life empowering therapeutic needs for your kids.

1. What are Cookies?


1.1. Cookies are small text files stored on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website or use an App. They are widely used to ensure websites, Apps function properly, improve site, app performance, and provide a personalized browsing experience.

##

2. Types of Cookies We Use


2.1.

Essential Cookies:

These cookies are necessary for the basic functioning of the Site. They enable core website features, such as page navigation and access to secure areas of the Site. Without these cookies, certain services and functions may not be available.

2.2.

Analytical Cookies:


These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with the Site, allowing us to improve its performance and user experience. We use analytical cookies to track anonymous data, such as the number of visitors, the pages visited, and the sources of website traffic.

2.3.

Functional Cookies:


These cookies enable the Site to remember your preferences and settings, providing a more personalized experience. For example, they may remember your preferred language or region.

##

3. How We Use Cookies


3.1. We use cookies for the following purposes:

- To authenticate your access to secure areas of the Site, ensuring data security.
- To analyze website traffic and user behavior, helping us improve our services and content.
- To remember your preferences and settings, enhancing your browsing experience.

##

4. Your Consent


4.1. By continuing to use the Site, App, you consent to the use of cookies as described in this Cookie Policy. If you do not agree with the use of cookies, you may disable them in your browser settings or refrain from using the Site.

4.2. Please note that disabling certain cookies may impact the functionality and performance of the Site, and some features may not work as intended.

##

5. Managing Cookies


5.1. You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Most web browsers allow you to delete or block cookies, as well as configure cookie settings for individual websites.

##

6. Third-Party Cookies


6.1. While we strive to control the cookies used on our Site and App directly, it is important to note that third-party cookies may also be deployed. These third-party cookies are not under our direct control and may serve various purposes. By using our Site and App, you acknowledge the possibility of encountering third-party cookies and consent to their use as governed by the respective third-party cookie policies. For more details on how these cookies function and for what purposes they may be used, please refer to the privacy policies of the respective third partie

##

7. Cookies Used for Marketing


7.1. While our primary use of cookies is not for marketing, remarketing, or targeted advertising, it is possible that cookies may be used for such purposes by third-party services integrated into our Site or App. By using our Site and App, you acknowledge and consent to the potential use of cookies for marketing purposes as governed by the respective third-party policies. We recommend reviewing the privacy and cookie policies of these third parties for more information.

##

8. Cookie Duration


8.1. The duration for which cookies are stored on your device varies based on the type of cookie. Session cookies are temporary and will be deleted once you close your browser, while persistent cookies remain on your device for a set period.

##

9. Use of Cookies for Website Analytics


9.1. We use analytical cookies for website analytics to gather anonymous data about website usage, such as the number of visitors and popular pages. This data helps us enhance user experience and improve our Site.

10. Changes to Cookie Usage

1.1. Pinnacle Blooms Network unit of Bharath HealthCare Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. ("Pinnacle") is operated by Bharath HealthCare Laboratories P LIMITED ("Company") and provides specialized Multi-Sensory, Multi-Disciplinary, Integrated Autism Therapy Services.

1.2. This Age Restriction Policy outlines the age requirements for users accessing and using the Pinnacle services ("Services").

Section 2: Minimum Age Requirement


2.1. Users must be at least [18] years old to access and use the Pinnacle Services.

2.2. The Services are intended for parents or legal guardians seeking Multi-Sensory, Multi-Disciplinary, Integrated Autism Therapy Services for minors.

Section 3: Parental Consent


3.1. For users under the age of [18], parental or legal guardian consent is required to access and use the Services.

3.2. The parent or legal guardian providing consent is responsible for ensuring compliance with this Age Restriction Policy.

Section 4: Account Creation


4.1. Users are required to install Pinnacle application, Login to Pinnacle application with their secured OTP delivered over their whatsapp account from Pinnacle Blooms Network official handle to access certain features of the Services.

4.2. Users under the age of [18] must have their account created and managed by a parent or legal guardian.

Section 5: Verification of Age


5.1. Pinnacle may use age verification methods to ensure compliance with this Age Restriction Policy.

5.2. Users may be required to provide proof of age, such as a government-issued ID, if there is a reasonable belief that the user is under the age of [18]. In the form of verifying Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, PAN Card, Government Issued Identity.

Section 6: Non-Compliance


6.1. Users who do not meet the minimum age requirement or fail to provide parental consent shall not be permitted to use the Services.

6.2. If it is discovered that a user provided false age information, their access to the Services may be terminated.

Section 7: Content and Services Suitable for Minors


7.1. Pinnacle may offer content and services that are suitable for minors.

7.2. Parents or legal guardians are responsible for monitoring their child's use of the Services to ensure appropriate access to content and services.

Section 8: Disabling Accounts


8.1. If it is discovered that a user under the age of [18] created an account without parental consent, the account may be disabled until appropriate consent is obtained.

Section 9: Reporting Unauthorized Access


9.1. Parents or legal guardians who discover that their child accessed the Services without their consent should immediately notify Pinnacle to disable the account.

Section 10: Liability


10.1. Pinnacle shall not be liable for any unauthorized access or use of the Services by minors. 10.2. Parents or legal guardians are responsible for their child's use of the Services and compliance with this Age Restriction Policy.

Section 11: Compliance with Applicable Laws


11.1. Pinnacle adhere to all applicable laws and regulations related to age restrictions and data privacy concerning minors.

Section 12: Changes to Policy


12.1. The Company reserves the right to modify this Age Restriction Policy at any time. Any changes will be communicated to users.

Section 13: Acceptance of Terms


13.1. By using the Services, users agree to comply with the terms and conditions outlined in this Age Restriction Policy.

Section 14: Governing Law


14.1. This Age Restriction Policy shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this policy shall be referred to and finally resolved by the courts of India.

Phone: [9100 181 181]

16.2. By continuing to avail our services after any modifications to the Refund Policy, you agree to be bound by the revised terms.

##

##

📖 Preface

Pinnacle Blooms Network is not a conventional institution.
It is the world’s most purpose-driven child development ecosystem — built on 344 skills, 79 abilities, 21 million+ therapy sessions, and a scientifically validated, AI-empowered pathway toward self-sufficiency, school readiness, and mainstream inclusion for children with neurodevelopmental challenges.

Behind every AbilityScore® recorded.
Behind every session delivered.
Behind every parent interaction…

…stands a staff member trusted to carry the future of a child.

⚖️ WHY THIS CHARTER EXISTS

This Staff Conduct & HR Compliance Charter is the legal, procedural, operational, and ethical foundation that governs how every individual within Pinnacle must act, respond, record, behave, and lead — from entry-level therapist to national leadership.

It aligns with:

Address parents as “Sir”, “Madam”, “Amma”, or “Nanna” per preference Always thank the parent after each session “Do you have any feedback or need anything from us?” — must be asked every Wednesday 🧭 authorization L5 + Legal AB-07 Use of offensive tone with HR/parents/staff L3→L4 Escalation 📊 Center Discipline Audit (CDA) Each center’s Zonal Admin or Discipline Officer shall submit a monthly audit: Dress code compliance (random weekly check) Video call posture (call center or remote staff) Behavior-based parent feedback snippets Hygiene and grooming infra report (including fragrance-free zones) This will be included in center grading and staff performance reviews. 📩 Parent-Facing Situations Policy In any interaction — whether in person, on phone, or on video — staff must: Sit or stand with respectful posture Avoid interrupting the parent Smile gently, not forcefully Never offer a medical label or false hope End every interaction with a warm “Thank you for trusting us” 📜 Declaration to be Signed Onboarding & Annually “I understand that my appearance, tone, and demeanor shape the way a child and parent experiences Pinnacle. I commit to conduct myself with full dignity, compassion, and professionalism every time I wear the Pinnacle ID.” 💬 Closing Statement A child sees more than we say. A parent observes more than we intend. And in every moment — you are not just a staff member. You are the face of India’s most trusted child empowerment network. Dress like it. Speak like it. Be it. 📱 Section 5: Device, Internet & Communication Policy Protecting Privacy. Enabling Precision. Enforcing Platform Discipline. 📖 Purpose In a digital-first therapeutic environment like Pinnacle Blooms Network — where AbilityScore®, TherapeuticAI®, and session logs are driven by real-time data — personal devices, internet use, and communication must be governed with absolute integrity. ✅ Secure handling of sensitive child data ✅ Controlled use of digital communication tools ✅ Prevention of distraction during therapy ✅ Elimination of unauthorized media or content sharing ✅ Enforcement of IT and information security governance across all roles ⚖️ Legal & Organizational Coverage Indian Information Technology Act, 2000 Indian Clinical Privacy & Data Protection Guidelines (MoHFW Draft) Internal Cyber & Communication Control Charter Evidence Act (as therapy logs and recordings are legally admissible) 👥 Who This Policy Applies To Category Applicability Therapists, HR, Finance ✅ Yes Admin & Reception ✅ Yes Call Center Executives ✅ Yes Center Heads & Zonal Leads ✅ Yes National Staff, NCC, BDC ✅ Yes Vendors & External Trainers ✅ Yes (as observers or guests) 📲 Device Usage Policy 5.1 Mobile Phones Rule Enforcement No phones during active therapy sessions Mandatory — silenced, airplane mode or off Phone use only during lunch breaks Permitted if not delaying any session No recording, photos, screenshots inside therapy rooms or of Pinnacle Prohibited unless authorized Phones kept out of reach of children Mandatory Call Center Agents wear headsets, mute ambient noise Required 5.2 Personal Laptops / Tablets Not permitted on therapy floors No offline bookkeeping, through Pinnacle official handle WhatsApp only for session reminders, feedback, approved therapy coordination Never share PDFs, dashboard screenshots, photos/videos without SR authorization All messages must be professional, signed with name and designation Example: “Thank you. Regards, Sangeetha – Occupational Therapist, Pinnacle Suchitra Center” 🔐 Information Security 5.7 Sensitive Data Protocols Child session videos, audio clips, screen shares are confidential assets Access to internal therapy reports restricted to assigned roles Device loss/theft reported within 1 hour to zonal IT & HR via SR No printing or downloading child records on personal drives 5.8 External Communication Control Media interviews, school visits, blog posts, public webinars pre-approved by National Care Center Speaking on behalf of Pinnacle without authorization = Level 4 violation 🧾 Device & Chat Violations Matrix Code Violation Level DIC-01 Using phone during therapy L2 DIC-02 Sharing child video/photo on WhatsApp L5 DIC-03 Unauthorized Zoom session with parent L4 DIC-04 Gossiping in team group about parent/staff L3 DIC-05 Personal files on therapy computer L3 📊 Tech & Communication Compliance Audits Monthly digital audits will verify: Unauthorized devices on floor (surprise inspection) Session log timestamp mismatches WhatsApp screenshot logs (HR-monitored groups) CRM usage vs phone follow-up gaps Response etiquette in call logs and email threads 🖋 Declaration of Compliance “I understand that phones, devices, data, and messages are not casual tools — they are windows into a child’s therapy experience and Pinnacle’s credibility. I commit to full compliance with the Device, Internet & Communication Policy.” 📣 Closing Statement Every message you send. Every session you log. Every phone call you make becomes part of a child’s record — and part of Pinnacle’s reputation. Act accordingly. Log responsibly. Communicate with care. 🔐 Section 6: Confidentiality & Data Handling Policy Privacy Is a Right. Data Is a Responsibility. Protection Is the Pinnacle Standard. 📖 PURPOSE Pinnacle Blooms Network handles the most sacred form of data — a child’s developmental reality. From session videos to parent discussions, from AbilityScore® records to therapy logs — every byte represents a family’s vulnerability, trust, and hope. This policy governs the collection, usage, access, storage, transmission, and destruction of sensitive personal and therapy-related data across Pinnacle’s nationwide and global operations — and ensures full compliance with law, ethics, and scientific accountability. ⚖️ LEGAL & REGULATORY BASIS Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures) Rules, 2011 – India Personal Data Protection Bill – Draft (India, 2023) The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 MoWCD Child Privacy Guidelines Pinnacle’s Global IP, Scientific & Clinical Governance Framework 🧠 SCOPE OF PROTECTION Data Type Examples 🎯 Personally Identifiable Info (PII) Child name, age, school, diagnosis, family member details 🎥 Visual & Audio Content Recorded therapy clips, parent sessions, audio feedback 📊 Scientific & Clinical Records AbilityScore®, session logs, Behavioral Observations 📄 Financial & Consent Data Invoice data, SEVA documentation, parental approvals 🗣️ Conversations Parent reports, therapist opinions, center discussions 📌 CORE POLICIES 6.1 Access Control Rule Enforcement Only authorized therapists may view/edit a child’s session logs Mandatory TherapeuticAI®, AbilityScore® can only be accessed by the assigned team Enforced via login control Center Heads cannot view children from other centers Geo-role locked Data must be accessed only from official systems Personal laptop/tablet usage = Prohibited 6.2 Storage & Transfer Therapy logs must be entered only into Pinnacle’s secure platform No offline records unless expressly authorized Any physical records must be stored in locked, access-controlled cabinets Data must never be transferred over: WhatsApp; Gmail/Outlook personal ID; Google Drive personal; USB drives, external HDDs, or pen drives 6.3 Destruction Policy Expired session notes (beyond retention period) must be shredded/digitally purged Unused physical reports must be destroyed by center head in HR-verified protocol Exit staff must surrender all physical/digital data upon last working day 6.4 Parent Consent Management Every child must have a signed or digitally acknowledged consent form prior to any: Assessment; AbilityScore® screening; Therapy initiation; Video recording Consent forms are stored in the parent CRM and governed by data retention SOP 🚫 STRICTLY PROHIBITED ACTIONS Code Violation Level CDH-01 Taking session video on personal phone L5 CDH-02 Sharing child’s report with non-family via WhatsApp L5 CDH-03 Discussing a child’s diagnosis in front of other parents L5 CDH-04 Leaving paper files open on front desk L5 CDH-05 Forwarding any child image to other therapists L5 CDH-06 Carrying session logs home without approval L5 📊 DATA ACCESS MONITORING & AUDITS Activity Frequency Audit Team System login & download trace Weekly IT + Compliance Random session note access review Monthly Zonal Audit Child file visual security check Surprise audits HR + Center Head Exit compliance (Data surrender audit) Per exit Admin + Zonal Audit reports are reviewed quarterly by the Ethics & Information Security Committee. 🧾 THIRD-PARTY & VENDOR CLAUSE Any third-party trainer, app, or tech provider accessing child data must sign Pinnacle’s Data Handling NDA, submit monthly audit of access log, and be approved by National Compliance Office Failure = Contract Termination + Legal Notice 📋 STAFF DECLARATION (TO BE SIGNED DIGITALLY & ONBOARDING) “I understand that child data is not mine. It is protected, personal, and governed by law and ethics. I shall access it only when required for therapeutic duty and never share, misuse, or expose it without express written consent from authorized personnel.” 📣 CLOSING STATEMENT The world runs on information. But at Pinnacle, we run on confidentiality. Because what you carelessly forward today… might be a child’s future case file, a parent’s privacy risk, or a national-level ethics breach tomorrow. So lock it. Guard it. Respect it. ⚖ Section 7: Misconduct Matrix & Disciplinary Action System Accountability Is Not Punishment. It’s Protection — for the Child, the Parent, and the Brand. 📖 PURPOSE This section establishes the official classification system for staff violations — and defines the action-oriented response mechanism that governs how misconduct is: 🧠 Identified 🧾 Documented 🚨 Escalated ⚖ Penalized 🤝 Rehabilitated (where possible) It ensures a zero-ambiguity, legally enforceable, and audit-traceable framework to protect Pinnacle’s scientific, ethical, and human-first mission. ⚖ LEGAL BACKING Indian Labour Law & Model Standing Orders IPC Sections: 406 (Breach of Trust), 409 (Misuse of Responsibility), 354 (Verbal Misconduct) RPWD Act, 2016 (Rights of Persons with Disabilities) Internal Compliance Framework of Bharath Healthcare P LIMITED Terms of Employment & Offer Letter Signed by Every Employee 🧭 STRUCTURE: 5 LEVELS OF STAFF MISCONDUCT Level Category Nature Typical Action L1 Minor Negligence, Process Deviation Verbal Warning or Informal Note L2 Moderate Repeated Delay, Uniform Violation, Phone Use Written Memo + Warning L3 Major Missed Sessions, Gossip, Poor Conduct Memo + Recovery + Coaching L4 Severe Tampering, Backdated Logs, Parent Disrespect Final Memo + Suspension (3–7 days) L5 Grave Fraud, Abuse, Data Breach Termination + Legal Escalation 🔍 DETAILED MISCONDUCT MATRIX Code Misconduct Level Escalation Authority PCT-01 Repeated late arrivals (>3/month) L2 Center Head BIO-01 Biometric proxy or manipulation L4 HR + Zonal THR-02 Missed therapy session without reason L3 Therapy Lead THR-04 Ghost session (no child, still logged) L5 Ethics DOC-01 Backdated therapy notes L4 Zonal Clinical DOC-02 Copied/templated child progress notes L3 Therapy Head BEH-01 Verbal disrespect to parent L4 Ethics + HR BEH-04 Gossip or defamation within team L3 Center Lead APP-01 physical) Sexual harassment Taking gifts, money, or private favors Therapy fraud (fake notes, backdated entries) Sharing session videos/images externally Using therapy data for personal social media Audit Log HR + Zonal L4 Final Memo + Suspension (3–7 days) Memo + Ethics Flag National Panel L5 Termination + Legal Notification HR Legal Dossier Ethics Committee + Director Office 🔁 RECURRENCE ESCALATION RULE Repeating an L2 violation three times = escalate to L3 Repeating an L3 violation = L4 Final Memo L4 + any future incident (of any kind) = L5 Termination Window 📊 DISCIPLINARY DASHBOARD & AUDIT TRAIL Every memo must include: Date Incident Description Evidence Escalation Authority Staff Response Remediation (if any) Closure Date Monthly reports shared with: Zonal Leadership National Ethics Committee Board-level Compliance Review (Quarterly) 🖋 EMPLOYEE ACKNOWLEDGEMENT “I hereby acknowledge that I understand and accept the Disciplinary Matrix of Pinnacle Blooms Network. I accept that violations of conduct, therapy integrity, attendance, data policy, or ethical trust may result in action including termination or prosecution.” 📣 FINAL MESSAGE TO STAFF This matrix is not a threat. It is a mirror. • If you act with honor — it protects you. • If you fall short once — it guides you. • If you violate deeply — it holds you accountable. This is how the world’s most trusted child development network protects the children it serves — and the professionals who serve them. 🫱🫲 Section 8: Staff Grievance & Fair Hearing Panel Because Justice Should Not Only Be Delivered — It Should Be Experienced. 📖 PURPOSE In an organization like Pinnacle Blooms Network — built by mothers, driven by science, trusted by families — we must ensure that our own staff are treated with the same fairness, clarity, and dignity that we offer every child and parent. This section outlines the structured process for raising, reviewing, and resolving staff grievances — across interpersonal issues, policy violations, favoritism, unethical management, career obstruction, or retaliation. This panel is not about hierarchy. It is about restoring balance and amplifying unheard voices within the organization. ⚖ LEGAL & SYSTEMIC FOUNDATION Indian Labour Codes on Grievance Redressal (Standing Orders, IR Code, etc.) Vishaka Guidelines (for gender dignity and workplace safety) Pinnacle’s Internal HRM Disciplinary & Appraisal Rules Universal Principles of Fair Hearing (Natural Justice Doctrine) 👥 WHO CAN RAISE A GRIEVANCE? Staff Type Eligible to Raise Therapists (all streams) ✅ Yes Admin & Reception ✅ Yes Call Center Executives ✅ Yes Zonal Heads, NCC, BDC ✅ Yes (to National Panel) Probationary/New Joiners ✅ Yes Exit Staff (within 24 hrs) ✅ Yes 🛑 TYPES OF GRIEVANCES ACCEPTED Category Examples 🧍 Interpersonal Conflict Bullying by center manager, favoritism, groupism ⚖ Unfair Disciplinary Action Wrong memo, biased audit, skipped version of events 🪙 Payroll or Leave Disputes Salary shortfall, comp-off denial, leave blocked 🎓 Career Progression Issues Promotion blocked due to bias, unequal learning access 🚨 Ethical Retaliation After whistleblowing, reporting fraud, resisting pressure 🧑⚖ Harassment or Hostile Behavior Verbal abuse, sexual misconduct, caste/faith/color bias 🛠 HOW TO RAISE A GRIEVANCE 8.1 Accepted Submission Modes 📝 Pinnacle Grievance Form – Service Request Route 📩 Email to: care@pinnacleblooms.org ✍️ Written letter to Center Head/Zonal HR ☎️ Call-in option for remote field staff All grievances must be acknowledged within 48 working hours. 8.2 Grievance Submission Must Include Name (optional if anonymity requested) Employee ID Center Name Description of incident (date, what happened, who was involved) Desired outcome (if applicable) 👨🏽‍⚖️ Fair Hearing Panel Structure Role Mandated Composition HR Representative Not from the same center Peer Staff Advocate Same-level peer from a different center Ethics / Ombudsperson Senior-level external/neutral party Gender-matched panelist required in gender-based cases. Escalation to National Board for L4/L5 complaints or unresolved grievances. 🔁 Case Flow Timeline Step Timeline Responsible Unit Acknowledgement Within 48 hours HR Preliminary Inquiry Within 5 working days Panel Staff Response Opportunity Within 3 working days Opposing Party Final Decision Issuance Within 15 working days Panel Chairperson Closure + Signed Report Within 20 working days National Compliance Registry Urgent protection cases may be fast-tracked to 72 hours. 📜 Outcomes May Include Outcome Applicable To Warning or Apology Opposing staff, if violation is minor Memo Reversal If original memo was unfair Role Transfer If ecosystem is deemed hostile Policy Clarification If SOP confusion triggered grievance Termination / Escalation In case of verified major misconduct Staff Recovery Coaching For emotional/mental support of grieved party 🧾 No Retaliation Guarantee Any retaliation, bias, or hostility following a staff grievance will be treated as a Level 4 violation Will be subject to panel review and penalty May lead to managerial disqualification from promotions 🧭 Right to Escalate If the staff member is dissatisfied with the outcome, they may: File a secondary appeal to the National Director (within 7 days) Request a re-audit by an external HR compliance specialist All escalation requests must be responded to within 7 business days. 📣 Final Note to Every Employee We built this panel because even good systems can make mistakes. And when that happens — you deserve a way to be heard, without fear. At Pinnacle, you will never be silenced, mocked for asking, or punished for speaking the truth. Because we are not just building therapy systems. We are building a culture of courage, clarity, and fairness — for you too. 🧭 Section 9: Conflict Of Interest & Undue Benefit Policy Transparency Isn’t Just Policy — It’s the Oxygen of Trust. 📖 Purpose At Pinnacle Blooms Network, every staff action impacts a child’s future. This section ensures that all employees act exclusively in the best interest of the child, the family, and the institution — without being swayed by personal profit, undisclosed affiliations, or hidden agendas. This policy establishes legally enforceable and ethically non-negotiable boundaries around conflicts of interest, undue benefit, external engagements, and parallel therapy practices. ⚖️ Legal & Ethical Basis Indian Labour Law & Model Employment Codes Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 (undue benefit clause) The RPWD Act, 2016 (protecting vulnerable populations from exploitation) Internal IP, Ethics, and Brand Protection Agreements of Bharath Healthcare P LIMITED Global best practices in data ethics, therapy integrity, and child-first governance 📌 Definition of Conflict of Interest A Conflict of Interest arises when a staff member: Uses Pinnacle’s platform, time, or brand to promote private gain or external interest Makes a decision or recommendation based on self-benefit, family ties, or external influences Conducts therapy, assessments, or interactions outside Pinnacle’s official framework 🚫 What Is Strictly Prohibited 9.1 Undisclosed Therapy Services Violation Example 🛑 Pinnacle’s name Running side “therapy camps” 9.3 Platform Misuse Violation Example 🛑 Downloading child data for personal clinic use Exporting records or screen recordings 🛑 Building an off-book client list using Pinnacle walk-ins Offering side consultations on weekends 🧾 Mandatory Declaration Protocol Timing Action 🟡 Onboarding All new staff must sign a “Conflict of Interest Non-Engagement Affidavit” 🔁 Quarterly All staff must submit a digital “Conflict Disclosure Form” 🔄 Event-triggered Any new side gig, family-run center, or school tie-up must be declared within 7 days 🛠️ Enforcement & Actions Code Violation Level COI-01 Undisclosed private therapy with Pinnacle family L5 COI-02 Recommending external clinic/center L4 COI-03 Accepting money/gift/commission for influence L5 COI-04 Running a parallel therapy setup (covert) L5 COI-05 Vendor collusion or supply kickbacks L4 COI-06 Using child data or videos for private channels L5 📊 Audit & Detection System Method Frequency Owner documented 🧯 Whistleblower Protection Any staff reporting a conflict of interest or undue benefit scheme will be protected under anti-retaliation provisions May report via anonymous ethics form, email, or grievance panel Shall receive confidential review within 10 working days 📣 Closing Statement Your decisions must be clear. Your intentions must be clean. Your loyalty must be to the child, the science, and the system. Because at Pinnacle — there is no space for private benefit in public service. No therapy for personal profit at the cost of trust. This is our firewall. This is our reputation. This is our way forward. This Charter reflects not just the policies of a company — but the dreams of millions of children and mothers who’ve waited to be seen. We uphold this not as a rulebook, but as our promise to Bharat and the world. 📖 Preface

The Soul of Pinnacle

At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we are not merely delivering therapy.
We are guarding the future of children — one milestone, one AbilityScore®, one voice at a time.

Behind every session entered… …is a promise made to a parent.
Behind every AbilityScore®… …is a battle fought by a child to be understood.

This Ethics Charter is not a technical document.
It is a sacred covenant — between the system and the soul.

We crafted this not to enforce fear,
but to enshrine courage, compassion, and accountability.

Every therapist. Every admin. Every manager. Every leader. Every Employee…
…is now bound not just by contract, but by conscience.

This Ethics Charter ensures that:

  • Silence will never shield abuse.
  • Fraud will never wear the mask of performance.
  • No milestone will be falsified for comfort.
  • And the unheard — will always have a voice.

Pinnacle does not stand on branding. Pinnacle stands on truth.
And this document ensures that truth will never be compromised.

For 90 crore children.
For every mother who waited long to hear “Amma.”
For every father who believes progress is possible.
For Bharat. And for the world.

🧭 Section 1: Report An Ethical Concern

Where Courage Meets Process. Where Silence Ends. Where Justice Begins.

📖 PURPOSE

The true power of an ethical system lies not in written codes — but in the ability of anyone to speak up safely and be heard seriously.

This section establishes a multi-channel, secure, and accountable grievance mechanism that allows any individual connected with Pinnacle Blooms Network — staff, parent, caregiver, vendor, or visitor — to report any form of unethical behavior, child risk, or integrity breach without fear of retaliation.

🧒 WHO CAN REPORT?

StakeholderAccess
Therapists (All Disciplines)✅ Yes
Admin/Call Center Staff✅ Yes
Zonal/Center Heads✅ Yes
Parents/Guardians✅ Yes
Caregivers/Visitors✅ Yes
Vendors/Consultants✅ Yes
Exit Staff (within 30 days)✅ Yes
External Observers (schools, NGO partners, etc.)✅ Yes (with verification)

🚨 TYPES OF ETHICAL CONCERNS THAT CAN BE REPORTED

CategoryExamples
🧒 Child Safety ViolationYelling at child, rough handling, isolation, neglect, abuse
⚖ Therapy FraudGhost sessions, fake notes, AbilityScore® manipulation
🤐 RetaliationManagerial harassment after reporting a concern
🧍 Unethical Leadership BehaviorFavoritism, bias, conflict of interest, intimidation
🪙 Undue BenefitAccepting money/gifts from families or vendors
🧾 Data MisuseSharing child photos/videos without consent
💬 Inappropriate CommunicationGossip, threats, discriminatory remarks
👥 Groupism or MarginalizationExclusion based on caste, region, gender, background

📬 HOW TO REPORT AN ETHICAL CONCERN

  • 🔹 1. Pinnacle Ethics Service Request Portal
    Route: Staff App or Admin System → Raise Request → “Ethics Concern”
    Auto-generates Ethics Case ID, allows document/image upload
    Assigned to National Ethics Panel
    Status: Trackable + Response in 72 hrs
  • 🔹 2. Email to Ethics Committee
    📧 care@pinnacleblooms.org
    Clearly describe your concern, include evidence (if available)
    Can request anonymity or callback only
  • 🔹 3. Call Ethics Helpline
    📞 9100 181 181 → Ethics Desk
    Voice-based confidential submissions, 9 AM – 7 PM
    Escalated to zonal ombudsperson
  • 🔹 4. Anonymous Form (External Access)
    🌐 pinnacleblooms.org/ethics-report
    For vendors, exit staff, or third-party stakeholders
    No login required, optional receipt number via mobile/email

🛑 REPORTING SAFEGUARDS

ProtectionDescription
✅ Zero RetaliationAny retaliation = Level 4 violation & disqualification from promotions
✅ ConfidentialityName kept hidden from target until formal hearing
✅ Support OptionComplainant may request peer advocate or HR escort during case
✅ No Escalation RiskNo manager may override or suppress a filed concern
✅ Whistleblower RespectMay receive recognition for safeguarding the system

⏳ TIMELINE & CASE FLOW

StepTimelineAction Owner
Acknowledge ConcernWithin 48 hoursEthics Panel
Preliminary Review5 working daysEthics Desk + HR
Interview or Evidence RequestWithin 7 daysNeutral Officer
Final Hearing (if applicable)Within 15 working daysTribunal (Ethics + Peer + External)
Resolution SharedWithin 20 working daysEthics Chair
Closure Summary StoredArchived for 5 yearsEthics Archive

Urgent child safety issues are fast-tracked in under 72 hours.

📜 CASE OUTCOMES MAY INCLUDE

TypeExamples
🟢 Advisory OnlyFirst-time behavior misstep
🟡 Memo & CoachingEthics training assigned
🟠 Suspension & Final WarningBased on severity
🔴 Termination & Legal EscalationFor grave violations
📌 System ReformSOP revised if issue was policy gap

📣 FINAL DECLARATION

“Every time someone stays silent, a child is left unheard.
But every time someone speaks — we protect not just one child, but the truth behind every therapy session ever delivered at Pinnacle.”

This portal exists not to punish —
But to listen. correct. protect. and grow.

Because ethics isn’t a department.
It is the soul of an institution.

📜 Section 2: Pinnacle Code Of Ethics

Because Policies May Guide Behavior — But Ethics Govern Character.

📖 PURPOSE

This section defines the unshakeable moral framework that underpins every action, every therapy, and every decision at Pinnacle Blooms Network.

The Pinnacle Code of Ethics is not a list of dos and don’ts. It is a value-first constitution — designed to:

  • Build self-accountable professionals
  • Create therapeutic environments of dignity and care
  • Safeguard the trust of 90 crore children, families, and therapists
  • Prepare Pinnacle for global partnerships with WHO, UNICEF, NCERT, and IPO-grade boards

This Code applies equally to therapists, admins, zonal leads, HR, call center agents, national staff, and partners — across India and beyond.

🧭 FOUNDATIONAL ETHICAL PRINCIPLES
